title: Define LHR acceptance levels and a minimum dataset by level
requirements:
- Specify governed models for allergies, medications, diagnoses, results, procedures/encounters and documents, including status and provenance
- Define acceptance levels from conformant structured data to unstructured content
- Distinguish record, encounter, document and element-level metadata with cardinality and source
- Require governed extensions where clinically essential meaning exceeds IPS
- Support coexistence of structured resources, documents and narrative
- Require ability to represent domains rather than mandatory presence of data
- Specify minimum validation and labelled quarantine of non-conformant content
- Use a resolved person reference supporting the national identity model
